items.what: MPD constructor must accept a new keyword argument 'timelines' (and expose mpd.timelines) used to carry segment-number state between manifest reloads
Representation.segments() must accept an 'init' keyword parameter (init=False skips yielding the initialization segment)

Exact filtering semantics: on reload with the same/older publishTime, zero segments are yielded (empty list, no fallback to last-N segments), based on startNumber/segment numbering tracked via the timelines state
Segment numbering must honor startNumber (segments numbered 2..17 and 18..19), reflected in seg.num

reason: The instruction only describes filtering out already-downloaded segments on reload. The tests additionally require a new MPD(timelines=...) constructor keyword/attribute and a new segments(init=False) keyword, neither of which is stated or inferable, to pass state between manifest parses.
